name: wp-lab
description: Local WordPress lab for testing plugins and themes, with a minimal default theme.

interface.shortDescription: Run a local WordPress sandbox with a default theme.
interface.longDescription: WP Lab gives Codex a local WordPress sandbox workflow with Docker Compose, mounted plugin and theme folders, a minimal default theme, automatic first-run WordPress setup, and scripts for starting, stopping, resetting, and opening the test site.
defaultPrompt: Add this WordPress plugin to WP Lab.
Help me test a WordPress theme.
